plan_metadata.title: UI Refinement: Job Title Removal, Loading State, and Textarea Optimization
plan_metadata.author: gemini

_analysis_notes.summary: This plan addresses three UI/UX improvements: removing the optional job title field, implementing a more prominent loading state during CV screening, and capping the job description textarea height to prevent layout breaks.
important_constraints: Ensure the loading overlay is center-aligned and blocks interaction
assumptions: The user wants 'loading' to be a full-component overlay rather than just the button state
A max-height of 400px for the textarea is optimal for standard viewports
risks: Z-index conflicts with PrimeNG toast or global elements

steps.title: Remove Job Title from Component Logic
steps.description: In AnalyzeComponent (analyze.component.ts), delete the 'jobTitle' property and update the onSubmit method to use a default string (e.g., 'Screening Results') in the navigation state instead of 'this.jobTitle'.
steps.validation: Check that analyze.component.ts compiles without unused property errors.

steps.title: Remove Job Title from Template
steps.description: In analyze.component.html, delete the 'form-group' div block (lines 29-40) containing the Job Title label and input field.
steps.validation: Verify the Job Title field is no longer visible in the UI.

steps.title: Implement Loading Overlay Component
steps.description: Add a div with class 'loading-overlay' to analyze.component.html, containing a p-progressSpinner and a text status. This overlay should only be visible when 'isScreening' is true.
steps.validation: Check that the overlay appears when the screen button is clicked.

steps.title: Import ProgressSpinnerModule
steps.description: Add ProgressSpinnerModule to the imports array in analyze.component.ts.
steps.validation: The application should compile without template errors for p-progressSpinner.

steps.title: Style Loading Overlay and Textarea
steps.description: In analyze.component.scss, add styles for '.loading-overlay' (position: fixed, display: flex, background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8), z-index: 1000) and set 'max-height: 400px' with 'overflow-y: auto' for '#jobDescription'.
steps.validation: Verify the overlay covers the form and the textarea does not exceed 400px in height.
